workbench: Quotation assistant for pipe fitting foundries
chooseInquiry: Select a saved inquiry or start a new one.
title: Inquiry title
inquiryPlaceholder: Include the product, specification and number of cartons. Specify a grade if required.
imageHelp: Upload a clear PNG, JPEG or WebP image up to 5 MB.
ocrExpired: Image recognition timed out. You can retry.
recognizedTextPlaceholder: Enter or correct the inquiry text against the image.
sampleInquiry: 玛钢 90°弯头，规格 25，1 箱；玛钢三通，规格 25，1 箱。
syntheticOnly: Use synthetic inquiry text or images with the demo catalog.
identifying: The assistant is identifying catalog items and carton quantities.
retryExpired: The identification window has expired. Retry to start a new attempt.
reviewHelp: Check each line’s category, product name, specification, cartons and grade before confirming.
quoteHelp: All prices and amounts use the synthetic catalog.
quotePendingPrice: Cannot quote until price is set
error.unknown: The operation could not be completed. Try again.
error.request_failed: The workbench request failed. Refresh and try again.
error.request_timeout: The workbench did not respond in time. Refresh before retrying.
error.invalid_input: Enter a title and inquiry text within the field limits.
error.invalid_image: Choose a PNG, JPEG or WebP image up to 5 MB.
error.unsupported_image: Use a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
error.image_too_large: Inquiry images must be 5 MB or smaller.
error.ocr_failed: Image text extraction failed. Retry or enter the text from the original image.
error.ocr_unreadable: No usable inquiry text was found. Retry or enter the text from the original image.
error.ocr_timeout: Image recognition timed out. Retry or enter the text from the original image.
error.ocr_pending: Image text is being extracted. Refresh to check progress.
error.gpt_required: The image recognition model was unavailable. Enter the text from the original image or retry.
error.vision_model_required: Image recognition requires DeepSeek Flash as the default model. You can enter the text from the original image.
error.model_unavailable: The recognition model is temporarily unavailable. Your text or image has been kept. Please retry later.
error.not_found: This inquiry is unavailable. Select another saved inquiry.
error.forbidden: You do not have access to this inquiry or action.
error.conflict: This inquiry changed. Review the saved information and try again.
error.already_quoted: This inquiry already has a confirmed quotation. Refresh to see it.
error.analysis_pending: Identification is in progress. Refresh for the latest status.
error.analysis_expired: The identification window expired. Retry to start a new attempt.
error.stale_catalog: The demo catalog changed. Identify items again against the current catalog.
error.pricing_unavailable: Pricing is temporarily unavailable. Try again in a moment.
error.invalid_proposal: The assistant could not save valid catalog items and carton quantities. Check the inquiry and retry identification.
error.incomplete_coverage: Some inquiry lines were missed. Check the original inquiry and retry.
error.invalid_grade: The requested grade could not be determined. Check the inquiry and retry.
error.model_budget_exhausted: This identification attempt reached its call limit. Retry or simplify the inquiry.
error.invalid_catalog: The demo catalog could not be validated. Refresh and try again.
error.dispatch_failed: The assistant did not acknowledge the request. Refresh, then retry identification if needed.
error.analysis_failed: Recognition did not complete. Check the inquiry text or retry.
error.empty_lines: Add at least one item before saving or confirming.
error.not_found_product: No matching catalog item. Check the category, product name, specification and grade.
error.ambiguous_product: Multiple catalog items match. Check the product details.
error.no_priced_products: No line can be priced. Check the products, prices and units per carton.
error.incomplete_line: Enter the category, product name, specification and grade on every line.
error.invalid_quantity: Enter a whole number from 1 to 1,000,000 cartons on every line.
